The '''''Codex''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] written by the treasure hunter [[Brin Hesk'l]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in which he recorded the places that he had visited, the objects that he had recovered and the information that he had learned during his travels.
